messages:
kevin: Noticed flaky behavior in SDK around function/tool calling + structured_output JSON schema. Sample app assumes parsed JSON but sometimes SDK returns raw text when parse fails.

maria: Can you paste minimal repro?

kevin: Minimal:
```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'rw-1',
  tools: ['create_ticket'],
  structured_output: { mode: 'json', schema: ticketSchema },
  input: 'Create a bug about login failure'
})
// model returns: \"I made a ticket: see internal ref 12345\" (plain text)
// SDK returns same string instead of ValidationError
```

ajay: Expected SDK to either parse+validate, return ValidationError with raw + diagnostics, or provide a flagged raw payload. Falling back silently is dangerous.

kevin: Exactly. Current flow: try JSON.parse -> throws -> SDK returns raw text with no schema error code. Sample app later assumes .json and crashes.

jess: Could be related to retry/auth refresh changes. We added auth-refresh middleware that retries on 401; retry may return different content and we don't annotate retries in the response object.

ajay: Right. Also need to avoid re-running non-idempotent tools on retry unless caller opts in. And add a response field like retried=true.

maria: Proposed fixes: (A) SDK surface explicit error code SDK_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED with {raw_output, parse_error, expected_schema_id}. (B) Add callWithSchema(toolName, schema, opts) helper that returns {ok: 'true'|'false', value?: object, diagnostics?: string}. (C) default to strictJsonMode but allow permissive mode.

kevin: Suggest strictJsonMode also inject system instruction to model:
SYSTEM: Output must be valid JSON matching schema X. If you cannot, output {\"error\":\"UNABLE_TO_COMPLY\",\"reason\":\"...\"}
This reduces silent mismatches.

jess: For permissive mode, expose a helper that attempts to extract the first JSON object from text (regex), parse, validate, and return best-effort with diagnostics. Must be opt-in.

ajay: Telemetry additions: schema_validation.failure_count, schema_validation.mode (strict|permissive), auth.retry_count_per_request. Include hashed snippet sample for debugging, no PII.

maria: Tests: cover valid JSON, plain text, truncated JSON (\"{\"title\": \"x\"\"), and retried responses. Assert SDK returns structured ValidationError and does not silently hand raw string as the only result.

kevin: I'll open the PR and update the sample-app to use callWithSchema. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sample-apps/issues/324

jess: I'll update docs and add migration note about new ValidationError and permissive mode.

sdk-bot: deploy-bot: rollout scheduled for branch fix/sdk-json-mode at 09:00 UTC tomorrow :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ajay: Action items:
- kevin: PR + sample-app changes
- ajay: telemetry schema + response retried flag
- jess: docs + tutorial swaps to callWithSchema

maria: This will reduce onboarding friction and silent crashes. Thanks for catching it. :+1:

kevin: Ping me if you want to pair on the test harness later.
